name: Swisscubing Cup Final 2018
information:
[EN]
The SC Cup Final is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2018, made of 4 competitions during the whole year. Check out on https://swisscubing.ch/en/swisscubing-cup-2018/ for the details of the other editions.
